title: Every gig in one place
brief: Fans miss shows because our city's gig listings are scattered across venue chalkboards and three different socials.

target_population.role: listings editor for a fictional small-city gig guide
target_population.coverage_limit: one month of shows in one invented city; browse and save only, no ticketing

core_task.summary: filter shows by neighborhood and genre, then save one to a personal plan
core_task.success_oracle: filtering to Riverside and folk leaves exactly two listings, and saving Marrow Lanterns adds it to the my-plan tray with the tray count at one

not_applicable_states.loading: the month of listings ships as seeded local data and filters recompute in memory, so the list never renders a fetching or skeleton frame
not_applicable_states.validation-error: the guide is browse-only: neighborhood and genre are picker filters and saving is a single button, so no free-form input exists to reject

state_recipes.empty: filter to Old Mills plus jazz, a combination with no seeded shows; the no-shows panel suggests clearing a filter
state_recipes.success: filter Riverside plus folk and save Marrow Lanterns; the tray counts one with the show listed
state_recipes.focus: press Tab from page load until the neighborhood filter shows its visible focus ring
state_recipes.mobile: load the guide at 390x844; filters collapse into a top sheet above the list

acceptance_facts: The seed holds fourteen shows across four fictional venues and five neighborhoods within one month.
Filtering Riverside plus folk narrows the list to exactly two shows.
Saving a show places it in the my-plan tray and updates the tray count without leaving the page.

product_signature.mechanism: two-filter funnel that narrows a month of gigs into a pocket plan
product_signature.anchor: my-plan tray docked at the screen edge
product_signature.brief_trace: scattered across venue chalkboards and three different socials
product_signature.counterfactual: a static event table would fit a poster-archive brief and cannot keep a personal plan
product_signature.task_proof: success capture shows the filtered pair of listings with Marrow Lanterns held in the tray

anti_goals: no ticket sales, links to ticket vendors, or pricing
no artist images or embedded audio; listings are typographic
no accounts; the plan tray is a local, single-session record

content_seed.data_notes: fourteen invented shows; exactly two are riverside folk, and old-mills has no jazz so the empty filter state is deterministic
